subject: Re: Kickoff: depth from unknown cameras (video-in-the-wild)
body:
Status on the masking pipeline, six days late vs. the May 22 milestone but now live.

What shipped: automated segmentation masks for possibly-moving objects over our in-the-wild corpus, emitting Struct2depth-format triplets the trainer consumes directly. Throughput is about 40 clip-hours per day, so the full corpus is masked by June 9.

The risk worth flagging: mask quality drives everything downstream. On a 500-frame audit, 7% of frames had a moving object partially unmasked, and those frames are exactly where the depth net learns wrong geometry -- the paper's whole training setup assumes movers are masked out. Rosa and I are adding a dilation pass plus a confidence filter, which should cut leakage under 3%.

Baseline training starts Monday regardless; June 15 review holds.

Quentin
